instruction: Give a 4-star rating to all songs in my Spotify album library which I have liked. If I have already rated it lower, increase it to 4.

steps.code:
spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

albums = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    albums.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(albums))
print(albums[:2])

liked_albums = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_albums(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_albums.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(liked_albums))
print([(a["album_id"], a["title"]) for a in liked_albums])

library_album_ids = set(a["album_id"] for a in albums)
liked_album_ids = set(a["album_id"] for a in liked_albums)
target_album_ids = library_album_ids & liked_album_ids
print("Library albums:", sorted(library_album_ids))
print("Liked albums:", sorted(liked_album_ids))
print("Target albums (in library AND liked):", sorted(target_album_ids))
